arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
from h import *
def one(events, **kw):
    t = trace('a', events, idle_ms=0, **kw)
    r = run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]
    return r
def ACK(*rs): return F(type='ACK', ranges=[list(x) for x in rs])

sent = {'I':[[0,3]], 'H':[], 'A':[[10,10],[20,29]]}
base = dict(sent=sent)
# valid
print('A1', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((0,3))])])], **base)['packets'])
# not in sent
print('A2', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((0,4))])])], **base)['packets'])
print('A3', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((5,5))])])], **base)['packets'])
# A space: two ranges with gap
print('A4', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[ACK((20,29))])],auth=True)], **base)['packets'])
print('A5', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[ACK((10,29))])])], **base)['packets'])
print('A6', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[ACK((19,25))])])], **base)['packets'])
# malformed: empty
print('A7', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK()])])], **base)['packets'])
# reversed
print('A8', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((3,0))])])], **base)['packets'])
# adjacent
print('A9', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((0,1),(2,3))])])], **base)['packets'])
# overlapping
print('A10', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((0,2),(1,3))])])], **base)['packets'])
# unsorted
print('A11', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((2,3),(0,1))])])], **base)['packets'])
# H space empty sent
print('A12', one([dg(0,[pkt('H',0,[ACK((0,0))])])], **base)['packets'])
# ACK in Z -> preflight
print('A13', one([dg(0,[pkt('Z',0,[ACK((0,0))])])], early=True, **base)['packets'])
# ACK after a semantic effect in the same packet (order)
print('A14', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=0,data_hex='01'), ACK((0,0))])])], **base)['packets'])
# large ranges symbolic
big = {'I':[[0,1000],[1002,4611686018427387903]], 'H':[], 'A':[]}
print('A15', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((0,4611686018427387903))])])], sent=big)['packets'])
print('A16', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((4611686018427387000,4611686018427387903))])])], sent=big)['packets'])
print('A17', one([dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[ACK((1000,1002))])])], sent=big)['packets'])
EOF
